description: This file defines a class 'FormatWithLocationId' that implements 'ValueFormatter' interface, responsible for formatting location IDs into location names using LocationService. It is part of the OrangeHRM HR management system, specifically within the maintenance plugin's access strategy formatting module.

classes.name: FormatWithLocationId
classes.description: A class that formats location IDs into location names using a LocationService.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the name of the location for a given location ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LocationService instance.
